title: Background File Mover v2 engineering contract
description: Written contract frozen with group53. Runtime only implements separately qualified slices. x-* semantic requirements are not JSON Schema assertions.

x-semantic-rules: no trailing slash except root

ByteCount.description: Preserved numeric u64 for existing operator/status fields and legacy manifest v1. Not the new producer/manifest v2 wire size type.

x-semantic-rules: Expected-size map keys equal files exactly when supplied, regardless of checking setting.
No file path is an ancestor of another listed path.
UTF-8 byte limits and scalar validity require separate semantic validation.
Current setting requires map only before whole-set handoff; an exact confirmed replay remains 202.
Immutable identity includes supplied map presence and values, even when comparison disabled.
Exact valid Unicode scalars; username1..128 and password1..4096 UTF-8 bytes. No trimming/normalization, echo or credential logging. These transport bounds are not password complexity policy.
Process each occurrence, in submitted order; do not deduplicate.
Clients must preserve integer precision; JSON binary64 rounding is not allowed.

Group 49 requires immutable existing review-version/audit context in a retry header; exact header and per-job receipt requirements are fixed in API-CONTRACT-CLOSEOUT.md; implementation remains pending.
Raw job IDs are exact integer tokens: no booleans, decimal/exponent notation or binary64 rounding. JSON Schema alone does not check token spelling.
Counts sum to number of attempted list occurrences only for a complete response.
Acceptance counts do not mean work completed.

HistoryCleared.x-status: implemented increment142 (online, dashboard) and increment107/142 (offline CLI)

x-semantic-rules: Exact original path membership and stable file IDs; no duplicates or prefix conflicts.
Measured sizes and full content SHA-256 must match verified publication evidence.
All manifest UUIDs lowercase. Stored immutable bytes, not regenerated formatting, govern recovery.
Final engineering slice: PRODUCER-MANIFEST-CONTRACT.md fixes framing, exact writer bytes and bounds. Written P01 is frozen under group53; runtime and consumer qualification remain separate.
Files are in ascending numeric durable file_id order, exactly 0 through N-1; preserve the first accepted path/index mapping across unordered replay.

RetryReviewSnapshot.x-status: fixed engineering projection for future authenticated admin views; runtime integration remains required
x-semantic-rules: A matching epoch does not prove human inspection or authorize effects.
Copy existing reviewed state at deliberate click; no polling-based refresh of a pending request.
Fixed-key compact UTF-8 JSON encoding, valid scalars, integer tokens only; no duplicate or unknown keys.
Epoch array length equals ordered job_ids; repeated same IDs must have identical epoch values.
Null is nonauthorizing and never replaced with current state.
Reason is 1..512 UTF-8 bytes, nonblank, control-free; preserve exact text.
Existing instance identity and exact ordered selection digest must match; authentication and CSRF remain separate.

Wire selection binds the complete ordered request transiently. Durable receipts retain only exact own-job command projection and opaque internal key; never other selected job identities. See API-CONTRACT-CLOSEOUT.md.
Exactly one case-insensitive Mover-Retry-Context occurrence, after HTTP OWS removal.
Canonical unpadded base64url; no comma joining, padding, whitespace or nonzero unused bits.
Decoded bytes <=4096 and canonical JSON; full raw request head still <=8192 bytes.

LedgerBytes.description: Preserved u128 ledger decimal string, not physical disk measurement.

StoredPath.description: Existing validated stored relative path, preserved without normalization; not reclassified as a fresh producer request.

FileStatus.x-preserved-from: file-mover/src/lib.rs status_response: unknown measured size/transfer/attempt are null, never inferred from expectations.

ResumeAudit.description: review_epoch is the consumed prior epoch; do not substitute the current outer review_epoch.

CancellationStatus.x-status: implemented increment140 (state schema 15); admin confirmation and route follow in increment141
x-semantic-rules: Cancelled only after confirmed safe stop/reconciliation. Restart is not cancellation. File disposition stays unchanged.
Pending and terminal commitment races must preserve verified output and original custody; no success from mere request acceptance.

DeletionStatus.x-approved-behavior: Group 51: latest pass only while job tracked; one active pass; never automatic retry or post-clear results.
x-semantic-rules: Counts are actual confirmed deleted/failed selected owned names, not freed bytes. Unknown pending outcomes are not successful deletions.
Repeated observations of the same latest pass must not double-count targets.
DeletionStatus.x-status: implemented increment143 (latest pass per job; state schema 16)

x-semantic-rules: Legacy status preserves submission_id; do not invent a UUID or rewrite persisted legacy identity. Exactly one identity shape applies.
retry_review/cancellation/deletion are proposed extensions, not current runtime fields. Existing detailed status fields remain.
retry_review existing instance/job must match the enclosing job; null epoch is nonauthorizing and must never be refreshed in a frozen request.
Private custody paths are not status fields. No new filesystem probe for these reads.

JobStatus.description: Preserves omitted outer absent fields: no null error/state/details placeholders and no HTTP status JSON field. Proposed extensions require implementation.

source_folder.description: Submission directory relative to the source root recorded with the job; empty when the job was submitted from that root itself.

destination_folder.description: Job directory relative to the destination root recorded with the job (which may differ from the currently configured root for older jobs).

JobSummary.x-extension: Dashboard row extension approved 2026-11-12 (increment134): file progress, measured bytes (decimal string), folders relative to each job's recorded roots (source_folder may be empty for the root itself) and effective transfer mode. Current configured roots appear only in admin settings and may differ for older jobs.

ConfirmationToken.description: Opaque authenticated confirmation proof, returned unchanged. Engineering limits/expiry/staleness and group50 forgetting are fixed in API-CONTRACT-CLOSEOUT.md; codec/runtime remain unimplemented.
ConfirmationToken.x-status: implemented: cancel (141), clear-history (142), delete-data (144, one job per request, behind admin_ingress.allow_data_deletion, default off). HMAC-SHA256 proof 'c1.<expires_at>.<high_water>.<binding>.<hex>', per-process key, 300 s; delete binds the exact deletable selection fingerprint

x-semantic-rules: Only safely owned retained source/unfinished destination may be selected. Protect originals, committed output/manifests, foreign and uncertain allocations.
Coordinates describe existing job/file/attempt/location; never a new public identifier. Full private host paths and inode authority remain internal.
DeleteTarget.x-status: RetainedSource implemented in increments143/144 (state schema 16); unfinished destination kinds reserved, not implemented

ConfirmationPreview.x-status: implemented: cancel (141), clear-history (142), delete-data (144, one job per request, behind admin_ingress.allow_data_deletion, default off). HMAC-SHA256 proof 'c1.<expires_at>.<high_water>.<binding>.<hex>', per-process key, 300 s; delete binds the exact deletable selection fingerprint
x-semantic-rules: Ordered job_ids include duplicates and exactly match the future mutation body.
Only issue a proof for a complete bounded preview. No truncation or partial deletion authority.
Deletion proof binds actual selected owned identities and per-job state; reject stale selection before new effects. Missing jobs still silently skip.
Normal pages are ascending original job_id with limit default 50, maximum 256; no cross-request snapshot promise.
Cursor binds existing instance and pagination/filter semantics. Cleared rows are absent; no retained-owner listing or reconstruction.
Confirmation mode uses the same read route, not another action endpoint or confirmation dialog. Response bounds and all-selected preview rules are in ROUTE-SCHEMAS.candidate.md.
probe_timeout_seconds <= max_sample_age_seconds; enabled requires a nonzero byte or percent margin.

SourceSpaceAdmission.description: Cached observation only. Global retention read does not launch a filesystem probe.

RetentionDetails.description: Preserved reservation accounting includes every retained destination attempt; never physical free space or an inventory of unreceipted leftovers.

OperatorError.description: Preserved local/operator envelope. Known job_id is optional/omitted, not null. A false release flag on an operator error does not revoke an earlier producer 202.

AdminError.x-status: candidate admin envelope; login/session 401 keep their existing separate schemas
x-semantic-rules: Never fabricate completed counts after validation/storage/auth failure. Earlier committed occurrences may remain valid. No automatic deletion retry is implied by an error.
Actual latest-pass observations only. Acceptance does not imply completed deletion.
Dispatch every submitted occurrence; aggregate each observed latest pass/owned target once so repeated IDs cannot double-count files.
Group 51 preserves one active pass/latest results before clear. Empty/ineligible deletion-batch HTTP mapping remains proposed, not newly approved.
DeleteAccepted.x-status: implemented increment144 (one job per request; setting default off)

DecimalByteCount.description: Group 52: exact canonical decimal u64, 0 through 18446744073709551615. No sign, whitespace, leading zeros, fraction or exponent. New producer and manifest v2 only; existing operator numeric fields remain numeric.

x-semantic-rules: Recovery compatibility for still-tracked original legacy jobs only; exact stored serialized bytes/receipts govern recovery. Never rewrite v1 as v2.
Numeric u64 size_bytes is preserved; legacy identity is submission_id, not an invented recording UUID. No scanning/adoption of cleared files.

CanonicalRecordingId.description: Canonical response/manifest UUID; requests accept either hexadecimal case. No version/variant restriction.

AdminSettings.description: Read-only configuration snapshot taken at service startup (increment134). Paths and policy only; never key material, password verifiers or file contents. Certificate subject/notAfter are read from the loaded DER files.

x-semantic-rules: Optional in JobDetails: omitted when no problem was recorded, never null.
Informational only: never an effect receipt, retry authorization, custody fact or proof of safe disposition.
diagnostic is the bounded printable-ASCII worker diagnostic; it carries no paths or payload bytes. operation/errno are parsed from it when it has the '<operation> errno=<n>' form.
file_id is the decimal file index the failed step was processing, or null for job-level steps.

x-history-clear-policy: Group50: after safe stop/settlement, successful eligible clear forgets all source/destination linkage, ownership/accounting/inventory and action results. Files remain unmanaged; no post-clear cleanup or reconstruction.

x-finalized-slices.scope: Written v2 specification frozen with group53. Runtime implements qualified producer/manifest slices; other route/security implementation and consumer/release qualification remain separate.

x-approved-closeout-defaults.cancel_transport_replay: approved: dispatch against current stored state
x-approved-closeout-defaults.empty_deletion: approved: 202 zero counts and completion_pending false
